title: Italy and Switzerland: Rome, Venice and Mount Titlis
alt: The Colosseum in Rome in the late afternoon light
transport: Private airport transfers, rail between cities and a Swiss Travel Pass

stops.name: Rome
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in the centro storico near the Pantheon

activities.name: Rome hop on hop off bus tour
activities.description: A 24 hour open top ticket looping the Colosseum, the Forum, the Vatican and Piazza Venezia, so you set your own pace.

program.name: Rome
program.description: Two nights in the old centre, with an open top loop of the Colosseum, the Forum and the Vatican.

stops.name: Florence
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Renaissance palazzo beside Santa Maria Novella station

program.name: Florence
program.description: One night in the Tuscan capital, with the Duomo and the Ponte Vecchio a short walk from the hotel.

stops.name: Venice
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Canalside hotel in Santa Croce, ten minutes from the station

activities.name: Venice gondola ride
activities.description: A shared gondola with a guide, threading the back canals of the old city before turning onto the Grand Canal.

program.name: Venice
program.description: Two nights on the lagoon, with a gondola through the back canals and a free day for Murano and St Mark's.

stops.name: Zurich
stops.subtitle: Zurich → Titlis and the Rhine Falls
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Themed city hotel a short tram ride from the lake

activities.name: Swiss Travel Pass, four days
activities.description: Four days of unlimited travel on Swiss trains, buses and lake boats, plus free entry to most of the country's museums.

activities.name: Mount Titlis and the glacier cave
activities.description: The rotating cable car to three thousand metres, the glacier cave, the cliff walk and a chairlift ride over the crevasses.

activities.name: Rhine Falls boat tour
activities.description: A fifteen minute boat run to the rock in the middle of the largest waterfall in Europe, close enough to get wet.

program.name: Zurich
program.description: Three nights in Switzerland with a four day travel pass, the glacier on Mount Titlis and the Rhine Falls by boat.

expert.name: Sharon
expert.quote: Italy first, then the train over the Alps into Switzerland. Doing it in that order means the mountains are the finish, not the warm up.
expert.tip: Reserve the Rome to Florence and Venice to Zurich trains the moment the trip is confirmed. Italian high speed fares climb steeply as the date gets closer.

summary: Nine days from the Roman Forum to a Swiss glacier: two nights in Rome with an open top bus pass, a night in Florence, a Venice gondola, then three nights in Zurich with a four day travel pass, Mount Titlis and the Rhine Falls.
included: Included: 2 nights in Rome, 1 night in Florence, 2 nights in Venice and 3 nights in Zurich, all with breakfast; airport transfers; rail between the cities; a 24 hour Rome hop on hop off bus ticket; a shared Venice gondola ride with guide; a four day Swiss Travel Pass; the Mount Titlis tour with the glacier chairlift; a Rhine Falls boat tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
